svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Pick a neighborhood close to my job or college when I have one. → Choose the neighborhood
or area to search in before starting a house search.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Find neighborhoods where listings that fit my budget and requirements are clustered. → Cho
ose the neighborhood or area to search in before starting a house search.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Get recommendations on places from people who live in the target country. → Choose the nei
ghborhood or area to search in before starting a house search.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Contact the providers of the shortlisted places and narrow the options by how fast and how
completely they respond. → Reach a provider who does not answer through the app by findin
g the place's name, location or website and contacting them by email or phone.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search inside an area drawn on the map instead of only by neighborhood name. → Choose the
neighborhood or area to search in before starting a house search.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See a timeline of the next steps and what to expect after sending a request, including wha
t happens if it fails. → Keep all housing communication on the listing platform when the p
rocess is clear and fast.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Contact a provider with minimal information instead of filling a long form in which every
field is required. → Keep all housing communication on the listing platform when the proce
ss is clear and fast.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Also see, when a filter is applied, the listings whose owner did not specify that attribut
e. → Filter listings by price range, beds and baths, home type, move-in date, pets or util
ities, without being forced to fill every filter.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Filter listings by price range, beds and baths, home type, move-in date, pets or utilities
, without being forced to fill every filter. → Get an overview of the price ranges and ava
ilable options in an area I do not know yet.
